_note: Accessories catalog v1 — rings and amulets. No 3D mesh attachment; bonuses applied on equip as additive modifiers to the hero's stat chain. damageMult is additive (0.08 = +8% on top of weapon chain). defense is additive (0.05 = +5% DR stacked after armor). hpBonus is a flat HP add. VFX driven by ArmorVfxMap using the accessory's rarity band (rim-light/glow on hero mesh — no swing trail). Sold exclusively at the Jeweler (Sable Vey). iconPath = ItemIcons/<id> (transparent-background PNG, 512x512). Pricing: same rarity-tiered formula as weapons/armor (crystals gate rare+). Priced crystals-primary at higher tiers because accessories are Sable's specialty — aether/crystal work.

accessories.name: Iron Band
accessories.flavor: Plain iron, no gem, no guild mark - what a smith makes when someone needs a ring and can't say why.

accessories.name: Steadfast Ring
accessories.flavor: A silver band set with a chip of Oathweld-treated iron - steady as a promise made in front of witnesses.

accessories.name: Embercoil Ring
accessories.flavor: Emberhand wound this coil while the iron was still singing; it never fully cooled.

accessories.name: Heartward Seal
accessories.flavor: A Last-Pressing crystal seal cut flush to silver - the stone is said to dim slightly every time it stops a blow.

accessories.name: Ring of First Light
accessories.saga: One of the First-Light wonders - older than Elarion's name. The stone at its centre was pressed before the Heart was planted; it does not reflect light, it remembers it.

accessories.name: Traveler's Token
accessories.flavor: A road-luck charm carved from the first tree past Elarion's outer gate - carried out and never carried back.

accessories.name: Oathward Pendant
accessories.flavor: An Oathweld medallion sealed at a sworn-binding - the ward holds because the smith believed in what it was sealing.

accessories.name: Last-Pressing Focus
accessories.flavor: A Last-Pressing teardrop crystal in silver filigree - the aether it carries was pressed when the Heart still sang openly.

accessories.name: Elarion Amulet
accessories.flavor: City-mark work from the Bright Centuries - the rune on the reverse is the old glyph for the Heart, before anyone thought it needed protecting.

accessories.name: Heartstone Locket
accessories.saga: A shard of the Heart itself, pressed and caged by Wren at the Last-Pressing. The locket is dark iron and opens on a hinge; inside, the shard still pulses with the old light. Worn with the full Aegis set, the pulse synchronises with the Heart and returns a portion of absorbed damage as a ward.
